Description.Name: Triad Ablative Magazine Protection System
Description.Details:
Developed in 3063 by the Night Sentinels mercenary company, the Triad Ablative Magazine Protection System was designed to reduce the crippling repair and resupply costs of prolonged frontier operations. Each TAMPS installation protects up to two ammunition bins located in the same left or right torso, using a shared, replaceable ablative core to suppress ammunition detonations before they can damage the internal structure, weapons, or engine components. A 'Mech may mount a separate unit in each side torso. Although its protection is limited by the condition of its containment core, a functioning TAMPS can prevent damage more completely than CASE or CASE II and is considerably easier to repair or replace in the field.

The first protected AmmoBox explosion is fully contained. Following the first successful containment, the damaged core has a 75% chance of remaining operational. If it does, it can make one final automatic containment attempt when the remaining protected AmmoBox detonates, with a 50% chance of suppressing the explosion. The TAMPS is destroyed after this second attempt, regardless of the outcome.
